candidates.reason: Project the hour before aggregation, preserving NULL hours and COUNT(*) semantics.
candidates.sql: SELECT hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) AS projected GROUP BY hour

candidates.reason: Use window counts and DISTINCT to retain one row per hour, including the NULL partition, with BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Filter in a CTE before grouping, preserving the original calendar-day predicate and duplicate counts.
candidates.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM eligible GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID

candidates.reason: Use filtered aggregation and remove groups without qualifying rows, preserving NULL route keys and BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0
